'''Blartree blossom''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with a sweet scent, and one of the many plants grown on the [[Walking Garden]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
